explication: Data API Builder turns configuration describing database entities and permissions into REST, GraphQL, and MCP data APIs. The main request flow is client → API endpoint → authorization and query execution → database → JSON response. The repository also includes CLI configuration authoring, metadata discovery, caching, health and OpenAPI capabilities, plus optional embedding endpoints. The README documents the broad runtime flow; source excerpts are partial, so finer dispatch and wiring relationships are omitted where they are not shown.
